_readme: Hand-tuning for the auto-generated index. Delete an override and the builder falls back to the page's own <title> / <meta description>. Override keys: repo subfolder name, gh:<repo>, or netlify:<site-name>.

_howto.put it on the public index: Add "public": true to its override. Netlify and manual sites are private by default.
_howto.a site moved: Add "redirect": "https://new-url.com" to its override. The card stays, the link follows.
_howto.a site the builder can't see: Add it to "manual" - Cloudflare, Vercel, anywhere. "group" sets its heading.
